Professional Summary:

EPAM Systems Inc. Oct 2023 – Present
Senior Software Engineer Noida, India

Scalable Backend & Platform
• Designed and built highly scalable backend services to support AI-driven customs classification
workflows.
• Implemented event-driven architectures using RabbitMQ to decouple long-running classification,
reporting, and reprocessing jobs.
• Defined clear service boundaries and API contracts, improving maintainability and independent service
evolution.
• Applied TDD for core business logic, writing unit and integration tests to ensure correctness and long-
term reliability.

GenAI & Agent Systems
• Built GenAI-powered agents using LangChain and LangGraph to orchestrate multi-step workflows
such as classification, validation, and reporting.
• Implemented RAG pipelines using LlamaIndex with Qdrant as a vector database for semantic search
over internal knowledge and historical classifications.
• Designed prompt strategies and agent routing logic to safely execute backend actions from natural
language inputs.
• Integrated MCP (Model Context Protocol) to standardize context sharing across tools and agents.

Frontend
• Built conversational UIs that interact with backend agents via Streaming APIs.
• Improved frontend performance with caching, lazy loading, and optimized data-fetching, reducing
backend load and improving UX.
• Improved frontend performance through caching strategies, lazy loading, and code splitting, resulting in
~10% faster load times and 20% smaller bundles.

Tesit Technologies Inc. Feb 2021 – Oct 2023
Software Engineer Remote

• Led development of a high-performance PWA using Next.js, achieving 99% Lighthouse performance
and 100% SEO.
• Designed and built scalable video-processing microservices using Node.js and FFmpeg, supporting
~10k/day users.
• Containerized services with Docker and deployed Kubernetes auto-scaling to handle traffic spikes.
• Built AI-driven video auto-tagging pipelines using AWS Kinesis, improving content discovery.
• Delivered core user experiences including personalized feeds, in-app video editing, and real-time
messaging.
• Improved developer velocity by creating custom GitHub Actions for CI/CD.

Envirya Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Aug 2019 – Feb 2021
Software Engineer Gurgaon, India
• Built a custom, reusable form builder in React Native used across multiple projects.
• Developed MSME-focused mobile and backend solutions using React Native, Node.js, and MongoDB.
• Automated operational workflows using background services and Cron jobs.
• Developed RESTful backend services using Node.js to support web and mobile applications.
